property_summary: For any caller and any balance, calling withdrawBalance always sends the caller the full stored balance and leaves userBalance[caller] == 0 (the reference reverts on send failure so the storage reset cannot be observed when the transfer fails); the mutant that ignores the call result can leave other accounts' userBalance differing because it zeroes before a failing send and does not revert.
change_summary: Remove the explicit revert on failed call by replacing the call-with-check with a direct call whose failure is ignored (no revert on failed send).
